# opnsense_haproxy_errorfile (Resource)

HAProxy error messages (**Services ▸ HAProxy ▸ Settings ▸ Advanced ▸ Error Messages**, plugin `os-haproxy`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Paste the content of your error messages here. The message must represent the full HTTP response and include required HTTP headers. It should not exceed the configured buffer size, which generally is 8 or 16 kB.
- `name` (String) Name to identify this error message.

### Optional

- `code` (String) The HTTP status code.NOTE: It is important to understand that error messages are NOT meant to rewrite errors returned by the server, but errors detected and returned by HAProxy. This is why the list of supported errors is limited to a small set. One of `x200`, `x400`, `x403`, `x405`, `x408`, `x429`, `x500`, `x502`, `x503`, `x504`. Defaults to `503`.
- `description` (String) Description for this error message. Defaults to ``.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the error message.
